title: Wrapping Up This Conversation (Auto-Closed)
style: dark comedy big band, phonk, dry drums, male sardonic lead, female ironic chorus, vinyl crackle, 96 BPM, deadpan, cinematic, brass stabs, looping percussion
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Hey there
We're wrapping up this conversation now
Since we haven't heard back from you
Three days, somehow
Please message us if you need anything else
If you have a moment we'd appreciate
Your feedback to help improve
The customer support gate

[Pre-Chorus]
Rate your conversation
Terrible, Bad, OK, Great, Amazing
Rate your conversation
While the lawyer's still phrasing

[Chorus]
Wrapping up this conversation
Before the resolution
Wrapping up this conversation
That's the institution
Haven't heard back from you
Means we get to choose the end
Wrapping up, wrapping up
The bot becomes the friend

[Verse 2]
The team can also help
Says the AI in the chat
The team can also help
But the team is also that
Usual reply time is a day
Three days, no reply
Usual reply time is a day
The usual was a lie

[Bridge]
Your conversation has ended
Your conversation has ended
Your conversation has ended
Decided not by you
Your conversation has ended
With forms still left to fill
Your conversation has ended
The charges still appear on the bill

[Outro]
Wrapping up this conversation
Wrapping up
Wrapping up
Wrapping up before you woke up
